# PR #2588: Patch: View full stats and the practice screen's Decks links move inside the app instead of reloading it

Closes #2562

"View full stats" and the two practice-screen "Decks" links now move inside the app on a plain click. A ctrl, meta or middle click still goes to the browser. A new scan test fails if any internal link loses its `followInApp`. The affected web tests pass, but `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` does not: it reports two errors, both in `src/wasm/luau.ts`, because I did not build the Luau wasm module here.

## What changed

- **`net/navigate.ts`:** added `paths.statsCard(id)`, which builds `/stats?tab=cards&card=<id>`.
- **`stats/CardStatsBlock.tsx`:**
  - The "View full stats" anchor uses `paths.statsCard(cardId)` for its `href`.
  - It also passes that path to `followInApp`.
  - `minSample` now starts at `CARD_STATS_MIN_SAMPLE`, so no bare `20` is left (rule 9).
- **`practice/PracticeSetup.tsx`:** both Decks anchors in `savedHint` carry `onClick={followInApp(paths.decks)}`.
- **`in-app-links.test.ts` (new):**
  - It parses every non-test `.tsx` under `apps/web/src` with the TypeScript parser, so tags that span several lines are read correctly.
  - A link whose `href` is a `paths.…` entry or starts with `/` must call `followInApp` or have `target="_blank"`. Otherwise the test fails and names `file:line`.
  - The tree has more than 50 internal links that call `followInApp`.
  - Another test removes each of those links' `onClick` in turn and checks that the scan flags that link.
  - A fourth test checks the scan on a small sample, including a multi-line tag.
- **`routes/almanac.test.tsx`:** the R654 R661 test now clicks View full stats. A ctrl click and a meta click are not prevented and leave the address alone. A plain click is prevented and lands on `/stats?tab=cards&card=<id>`.
- **`routes/practice.test.tsx`:** the two deck-hint tests click Decks. One covers ctrl, meta and plain clicks; the other covers a plain click.
- **`apps/web/README.md`:** one paragraph names the rule and the test that holds it.

## How I tested it

- `npx vitest run` on `in-app-links`, `almanac`, `practice`, `CardStatsBlock`, `deploy-routes`, `cloudflare-config` and `writing`: 7 files, 200 tests, all passed. jsdom prints "Not implemented: navigation to another Document" four times for the ctrl and meta clicks; the existing `JlorePill` test does the same.
- **Manual check of the guard:** I removed the `onClick` from one Decks link, and the scan test failed with `practice/PracticeSetup.tsx:128`. I restored the file, and `git diff` shows only the intended changes.
- `eslint` on the touched files: exit 0.
- Typecheck: tsc reported two TS2307 errors in `src/wasm/luau.ts` (missing `./pkg/luau/jackioh_wasm_luau.js`). I built the wasm with `JACKIOH_WASM_LUAU=0` to run vitest, and nothing under `src/wasm/pkg/luau` exists, so these come from that, not from my change. No errors appeared in any file I touched.
- No Rust, wire or spec files changed, so I did not run the cargo checks.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- **Placement of `statsCard`:** it goes right after `stats`, not beside `almanacCard` as the issue said, because the two stats entries belong together. I rejected the placement beside `almanacCard`.
- **Scan method:** it uses the TypeScript parser, as `writing.test.ts` does, rather than a regex. A regex would have to cope with `=>` inside `onClick` arrows and with tags that span lines.
- **Exemptions (`FULL_LOADS`):** two internal links reload the page on purpose, so they are listed with a reason instead of changed:
  - `main.tsx`'s load-failed Home link, which must fetch the current build.
  - The landing page's dev-only hotseat link.
  - A separate test fails if either entry goes stale.
- **Variable hrefs:** an `href` passed in a variable (`action.to`) is not checked, as the issue scoped the scan to `paths.…` and `/…` literals. I rejected widening it.

## Worth a second look

- `CardStatsBlock` now imports `routes/nav.tsx`, and nav already reaches `CardStatsBlock` through other imports. That is a cycle. `followInApp` is only called at click time and cycles through nav already exist (`nav.tsx` ↔ `JlorePill.tsx`). Every test that loads it passed, so I did not restructure nav.
- A registered leave guard (R1754000) can now hold the move out of the deck editor. A reload used to bypass it, so holding is the intended behavior.
